title: Down into Vicrium
journal: The knight-captain's disc bears the mark of Vicrium, a mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. The lower galleries are shut behind a locked timber door; the gallery-boss, Ah-Zish, keeps the key, and an old adit on the creek bank goes round it through water where crocodiles nest. I'm to get into the lower galleries and find the knights' strongbox. Ah-Zish might give the key to good words or 100 gold, or it can be lifted from him. Smugglers have moved into the lower galleries; I may fight them or sneak past. All of it is a trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, which lies at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea; the order wants it found before the Unbound reach it.
objectives: Get into Vicrium's lower galleries, by Ah-Zish's key or the old lower adit. (marker: Ah-Zish, Door to Lower Galleries, Old Lower Adit)
Search the knights' strongbox in the lower galleries. (marker: Knights' Strongbox)

plan.going: The disc points to Vicrium, where the knights kept a strongbox in galleries now shut. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Go by boat to Seafalls and up the road to Vicrium; get into the lower galleries and find the strongbox.
plan.ways: Ah-Zish's key (persuade him, pay 100 gold or pick his pocket), or the flooded adit past the crocodiles. In the galleries, fight the smugglers or sneak past them.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. I opened the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike and took a bronze disc with the Vicrium mark. The Unbound drain and seal trees, and the order wants the Eye of Argonia, a jewel said to heal every tree, found before them.
Get into the lower galleries of Vicrium and search the knights strongbox there.
Get the key from Ah-Zish by talking, paying 100 gold, or lifting it; or take the old lower adit through crocodile water; smugglers in the galleries can be fought or sneaked past.
I do not know what the Eye of Argonia really is, what the Collector wants, or what the strongbox holds. I could learn more by talking to Ah-Zish and searching the strongbox.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: In the knights' strongbox lay an old parchment map: seven towers standing in the sea, and a crag shaped like a tooth on an island. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. It is all on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea.
objectives: Bring the parchment map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a map of seven sea towers and a tooth-shaped crag. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.

Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Nesh-Deeka already knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and named me Toh-Wo, "Secret-Speaker", the order's second rank, with 200 gold. I'm to choose the order's gift: a rapier or a quarterstaff. It is all on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea.
objectives: Choose a rapier or a quarterstaff from Nesh-Deeka. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I am a Toh-Wo now. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had not been and would not say how. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
terms: Toh-Wo: Nesh-Deeka: "Secret-Speaker", the order's second rank

Choose the order gift, a rapier or a quarterstaff, from Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Take the rapier or the quarterstaff; as a stealthy character I lean to the rapier.
I do not know how she listens, who her officer is, what the Eye truly is, or what the Collector wants. I could ask Nesh-Deeka or her officer.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka passed me to her officer, Never-Writes-Twice, who stands at the back of the same room; from now on I report to her. I'm to show her the map. It is all on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Never-Writes-Twice knew the crag on the map: the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle. She told me Cuts-the-Old-Knot was once one of the order, who went mad on sap and killed her minders. She marked the Grey Tooth. It is all on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea.

plan.going: The map leads to the Grey Tooth on Skeith Isle. Never-Writes-Twice says Cuts-the-Old-Knot was one of the order gone mad on sap.
